commonAssessment.delivery: All three closure.deliveryMode values are docs-merge. QUALIFY produces the pre-delivery reviewed-candidate certificate, with exact-head authority, merge/public readback and completed closure expressly pending. Runtime-merge needs a future preserved product counterexample and separately authorized bounded repair. No delivered/closed claim is made by this review.
commonAssessment.platformLimits: Disposable owned loopback origins and contexts only. Native policy acquisition is gated on actual browser/build geolocation and permission support. Deterministic Position/error injections and storage faults remain labelled consumer controls. No claim about real TablissNG, mobile sensors, owner profiles, real clipboard or Apple installation.
commonAssessment.reuse: Exact source/body/script/fixture identities and affected consumer ranges are reacquired. Fixture failures and unsupported capabilities remain explicit; no retries erase contrary evidence or silently expand accepted public proof.

resolvedNotes.resolution: Load-time preservation is captured before manual apply; later writable setItem success is permitted and reported distinctly from denied write.

original.failureMode: A03 combines non-destructive load with later manual apply. Explicit staging would prevent an executor from applying the load-time byte-preservation oracle after an intentional successful write, or treating getItem-only denial as setItem denial. The full plan already makes feedback result-based and tests writable recovery.
original.smallestCorrection: Capture malformed/v2 bytes immediately after load with no write. Then manual apply must reflect the actual write result: getter or denied setItem means session-only with old bytes; getItem-only denial with writable setItem may save successfully and replace the prior record.
